title: iPhone free for 12 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 12 min (since 00:42Z; released by lead). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: v9-best (owner lead; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next owner takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
Steward (mgmt-devices): answer the user here; the lead is the second tier (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
